newsitem.title: NORWAY: Greenspan sends Norway shares to record close.
newsitem.headline: Greenspan sends Norway shares to record close.

text.p: Norwegian share prices soared to new record levels on Wednesday bouyed by Wall Street's surge to a record high on Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's positive comments on the U.S. economy.
Oslo's Total share index reached an intra-trade high of 1,275.10 points before retreating slightly and registering a record close of 1,271.82, up 1.63 percent from Tuesday.
Turnover was healthy at 1.25 billion crowns.
Shares in industrial conglomerate Norsk Hydro, Norway's largest listed company, rose 2.56 percent to 401 crowns.

Shares in Petroleum Geo-Services ASA (PGS) jumped almost 10 percent to close at 406 crowns after the offshore services company reported a 53 percent surge in pre-tax profits in the first half from a year ago to $38.59 million. The Houston-headquartered company was the most traded share at 166 million crowns.

A dealer struck a word of caution among the generally bullish sentiment. "I think we will see a pretty steep plunge if things start to turn now. When the index is rising so quickly in such a short time there will always be someone who wants to take home profits after a while," he said.
